title: HyprShelld managed Hyprland configuration v1
description: Strict typed desired state for the tagged Hyprland 0.56.1 Lua configuration surface. Raw Lua, callbacks, and command strings are not accepted as state.

hyprlandVersion.$comment: Managed v1 writes only canonical patch-qualified versions in the supported 0.56.x minor; patch is uint32-bounded.

boundedCoordinate.$comment: Safety envelope for compositor-space positions, sizes, and relative deltas; values outside one million logical pixels are not useful managed state.

cursorZoomLevel.$comment: A positive toggle target or multiplier; Hyprland clamps the resulting cursor zoom to 1..100.

expressionVector2.$comment: Managed v1 persists resolved numeric vectors only; opaque Hyprland expression strings are excluded.

oneOf.$comment: Runtime validates this token with xkb_keysym_from_name, rejects XKB_KEY_NoSymbol, and stores the canonical keysym name. Punctuation keys use names such as comma and plus.

bindingKey.$comment: Managed bindings contain exactly one non-modifier key token. code values use xkb_keycode_t's legal 0..4294967294 domain; mouse buttons use Linux input-event codes 272..767.

actionModifiers.$comment: Canonical uppercase modifier tokens, each at most once and in stable order; the empty string means no modifiers.

oneOf.$comment: Runtime validates this token with xkb_keysym_from_name and rejects XKB_KEY_NoSymbol.

actionKey.$comment: Dispatcher shortcut injection excludes catchall, wheel, switch, and compound key forms. code values are bounded to tagged std::stoi's signed-int domain.

oneOf.$comment: Runtime compiles the selector payload with RE2 and requires a valid expression.

windowSelector.$comment: Closed canonical subset of tagged CViewQuery selectors. Prefix abbreviations and unprefixed class regexes are intentionally rejected.

windowTagToken.$comment: A leading plus or minus applies or removes a tag. Authored dynamic-tag asterisks are excluded from managed state.

workspaceSelector.$comment: Fail-closed managed subset: positive numeric IDs, exact names, and special workspace selectors. Alias and bracket-predicate grammars are excluded until a typed parser exists.

existingWorkspaceSelector.$comment: A selector which must resolve to an already existing workspace at application time.

workspaceSpec.$comment: Closed creation/navigation subset. Relative r/m/e workspace expressions are deliberately excluded from managed v1.

oneOf.$comment: Runtime additionally rejects Unicode control/format code points before querying monitor descriptions.

monitorSpec.$comment: Canonical, disjoint managed subset of tagged monitor config strings. Direction aliases and zero relative offsets are rejected.

staticMonitorSelector.$comment: Stable nonempty output name/description selector; context-dependent monitor navigation, numeric IDs, and catch-all forms are excluded.

monitorMode.$comment: Managed v1 intentionally excludes raw DRM modelines. Width and height are bounded to five decimal digits; refresh is greater than zero and below 10000 Hz with at most three fractional digits.

monitorPosition.$comment: Explicit monitor coordinates use the same plus-or-minus one-million logical-pixel safety envelope as typed compositor coordinates.

windowFullscreenStateEffect.$comment: A missing client mode preserves the tagged parser's optional client state.

windowOpacityEffect.$comment: If inactive or fullscreen is absent, emission uses active, matching the tagged single-alpha fallback. Override booleans map to each alpha token's optional override marker.

no_close_for.$comment: Milliseconds; bounded to the signed int storage used by the tagged window-rule applicator.

scrolling_width.$comment: Fractional scrolling-layout column width; bounded to the practical 0..1 domain used by tagged tests and float storage.

dpmsArguments.$comment: Managed v1 intentionally applies DPMS to all monitors. A targeted selector is excluded because the tagged wrapper silently broadens an unresolved selector to all outputs.
